wamn_test_selection.name: engine::tests::count_mode_accounts_for_concurrent_stores_and_keeps_the_heap_ceiling
coverage: Creates two live manual SharedCtx stores using an Engine and its clone; each allocates one 64 KiB page against the same engine budget (in_use=128 KiB).
Growth by two pages succeeds in Count above the 128 KiB aggregate advisory: in_use=256 KiB, high_water=256 KiB, would_refuse=1, refused=0.
A further two-page grow exceeds the fixed four-page per-memory ceiling and refuses; size remains three pages and in_use remains 256 KiB.
Dropping the first then second store refunds usage to 64 KiB then zero.
limits: The stores coexist; allocation/growth calls are serial. This is not a simultaneous-growth or CPU-parallel invocation measurement.
Native guest linear-memory accounting is not RSS. Count permits aggregate excess.
wamn_test_selection.arming: No live service, guest artifact, ignore flag, or credential input. Resolved locked Cargo dependencies must be available offline.

wamn_test_selection.name: engine::tests::enforce_mode_refuses_aggregate_growth_until_another_store_releases_memory
coverage: Disposable native Enforce engine has a three-page aggregate budget and four-page per-memory ceiling.
Two one-page manual stores share the budget; growing the first fills it. Growing the second refuses with its size unchanged and refused=1.
Dropping the first refunds usage, allowing the second to grow to three pages; dropping the second returns usage to zero.
limits: Does not enable Enforce in deployment. Growth calls are serial while both stores coexist.
wamn_test_selection.arming: No live service, guest artifact, ignore flag, or credential input. Resolved locked Cargo dependencies must be available offline.

wamn_test_selection.name: engine::tests::cancelling_a_guest_waiting_in_a_host_call_releases_its_memory
coverage: Instantiates a real two-page Wasm core module and polls its guest invocation into a pending host import.
Checks that the host call was entered and the shared budget holds 128 KiB, then drops the future owning the Store and checks zero.
limits: Cancellation is dropping a polled future/store waiting in a test host import; it is not a process-signal, active executor drain, or database cancellation proof.
wamn_test_selection.arming: No live service, guest artifact, ignore flag, or credential input. Resolved locked Cargo dependencies must be available offline.
